text:
Priya Das: quick sync: follow-up from the peel RFC — debating tenant-sidecar extract vs keeping a centralized enricher. want tradeoffs written down before we lock approach.

Omar Ruiz: sidecar wins for tenant isolation and fine-grained scaling, but ops cost and memory bump per node could be high. centralized keeps infra simpler.

Samir Patel: Can we do a hybrid: peel into microservice + optional tenant-sidecar for high-volume customers ('peel-and-fuse' pattern)? default central, sidecar for pilots.

Nora Li: hybrid sounds pragmatic. key questions: routing, data ownership, deployment orchestration, and cost model. Also: how do we keep fast-path latency if we re-fuse logic?

Priya Das: Good list. Proposed criteria:
- Latency delta target: sidecar p95 within 10ms of fused path
- Cost model: delta per-tenant tokens / day -> estimated monthly $ impact
- Migration surface: API contract must be identical. adapter shim for parity.

Omar Ruiz: Ops constraints: kube node pressure + per-tenant cache sizes. if sidecar, need shared mem-tier or a local KV with pre-warm.

Samir Patel: For parity we should implement an adapter proxy that supports header-based routing + transparent fallthrough. Pseudo-policy: header("x-tenant-mode") == "sidecar" -> tenant-sidecar; else -> central.

Nora Li: DB plan idea: central remains primary for writes for 2w after cut; sidecars are read-heavy and cache derived state. after backfill, switch ownership per-tenant. avoids dual-write for everyone.

Priya Das: Love that. We'll call it 'per-tenant ownership flip' instead of global dual-write. makes rollback easier. also add a pre-cut snapshot for any derived state.

Samir Patel: Telemetry: need per-tenant cost curves and prompt-level quality delta. gating thresholds: if quality delta > 2% or token cost increases > 15% for 24h, auto-fallback.

Omar Ruiz: Autoscaler config note: sidecar warmup should include synthetic prefix warmups and a ramp policy. Also set a conservative HPA target for 48h.

Priya Das: Draft config snippet for routing (pseudo YAML):
```
route: /enrich/score
routing:
  - when: header("x-tenant-mode") == "sidecar"
    to: tenant-sidecar
  - else: central-enricher
metrics: [latency_p95, token_cost, quality_delta]
fallback: central-enricher
```

Nora Li: I'll write the backfill checklist and snapshot steps. will include verification queries and sample size checks.

Samir Patel: I'll prototype the adapter proxy and a small sidecar image. estimate 10d for spike + canary.

Omar Ruiz: ops will build the warmup job and HPA profile. we need a cost estimate for infra impact.

deploy-bot: created issue ARCH-4977: "peel-and-fuse pilot: tenant-sidecar prototype" — https://tracker/ARCH-4977

Priya Das: Ok action items: Samir (adapter + prototype), Nora (backfill + verification), Omar (warmup + HPA + cost delta), I'll create migration policy doc and cost model. Weekly sync Friday 9:30am. If no objections, start spike monday. :rocket:

Samir Patel: ack

Nora Li: ack

Omar Ruiz: ack :100:

Priya Das: closing thread, will link RFC addendum and cost spreadsheet before EOD Thu.
